messages:
Sam (CEO): @here quick founders' pulse + ops playbook for the week. High level: 1) Private beta for EU sites on track for next Tue; 2) Dedicated capacity SLA uplift target to 99.95% this quarter; 3) small regression in hosted p95 we flagged — details below. Please skim and call out any blockers. :rocket:

Sam (CEO): Metrics snapshot (week): hosted p95 latency 128ms (+12ms WoW), error rate 0.32% (up from 0.18%), Dedicated utilization 72%, cost per 1M tokens down 8% after batching tweaks. Rolling canary for quantized-medium model this morning.

Priya (VP Product): Thanks Sam — quick ask: can we hold a 30-min sync tomorrow to review EU private beta onboarding checklist? I want sign-off on the compliance one-pager and customer install runbook.

Jordan (VP Eng): +1 on sync. On the hosted p95 regression: root cause looks like a KV cache eviction threshold change from last runtime tweak — we reverted the change at 08:12 and saw partial recovery. Full rollback scheduled if we don't see steady metrics by EOD.

Marta (Head of Reliability): Noted. I'm running an availability sweep across regions. If deploy-bot reports any autoscaler thrash, I'll open an incident. Also prepping a short postmortem template in #postmortems for any regression we decide to declare.

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout 'quant-medium-q2' started by jordan at 2026-03-23T09:04:12Z. 4/20 hosts healthy, monitoring in progress.

Priya (VP Product): For Dedicated SLA uplift: engineering, do we have a clear list of infra items that must land to hit 99.95%? If so I can align sales enablement and the legal SLA draft.

Jordan (VP Eng): Short list: 1) autoscaler hysteresis fix (in review), 2) regional fallback routing (staged), 3) infra-level health checks wired to the console alerts (in progress). ETA: most items by Apr 8.

Sam (CEO): Good. Priya — coordinate with Sales on a customer comms draft; include a fallback policy note and migration plan for current Dedicated customers. Marta — flag anything that looks like an SLO violation as soon as it crosses our alert threshold; I don't want surprises on the exec call.

Marta (Head of Reliability): Will do. Quick heads-up: if p95 doesn't stabilize after the canary completes, recommend we open a sev-2 and run red/green comparisons against the previous runtime.

Jordan (VP Eng): Acknowledged. If we open a sev-2, I'll be primary on remediation until we have a stable rollback.

Priya (VP Product): One more item — Redwood Optimize suggestion engine pushed new batching defaults last night. Early A/B shows improved cost but a tiny drop in output length for a subset of seq-gen prompts. I've queued an eval to measure user-visible regressions; results by tomorrow afternoon.

Sam (CEO): Thanks. Two asks for owners: (1) Priya — bring the EU private beta onboarding checklist and comms to the sync; (2) Jordan & Marta — confirm by EOD whether we need to open a sev-2 for the hosted p95. If not, confirm rollback plan and metric window for recovery.

Priya (VP Product): Got it. Sync invite coming shortly.

Jordan (VP Eng): Will report by 17:30 PT.

Marta (Head of Reliability): I'll alert if we breach the 0.5% error threshold or p95 > 180ms sustained for 10m.

Sam (CEO): Appreciate it. Short pulse only this week — keep ops tight, focus on EU beta readiness and SLA items. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya (VP Product): :thumbsup:

Jordan (VP Eng): :white_check_mark:

Marta (Head of Reliability): :mag:

Sam (CEO): End of thread.
